FIX 1 (MAJOR-6 + junk-accept, ingest.py): a TYPE BOUNDARY at the head of ingest_event(), before identity -- every channel-origin scalar is type-checked once via the centralized helper _require_str(name, value, notes, *, optional). Required fields (event_code/page_id/session_id/source/raw_event_hash) of a non-str type => fail-closed REJECT with audit FIELD_TYPE_INVALID (field name in detail), IngestResult(logged=False, egress_eligible=False), early return, NO raise. Optional fields (guest_id/consent_snapshot_id/correlation_id) of the wrong type => dropped to ABSENT + audit HOLD FIELD_TYPE_INVALID, value never used. NEVER str()-coerced (a list coerced to "['x']" is ingested GARBAGE, not fail-closed) -- this also closes the probe finding that page_id/session_id/source/raw_event_hash as a LIST were silently junk-accepted (str(list) baked into the RULE-005 idempotency key, logged=True). FIX 2 (MAJOR-7, the fail-OPEN, ingest.py): immediately after resolved_snapshot = consent_reader.get(handle_id), 'if not isinstance(resolved_snapshot, ConsentSnapshot)' => fail-closed, note+audit CONSENT_SNAPSHOT_UNTRUSTED_TYPE, resolved_snapshot set to None so the id is NEVER written to the append-only (RULE-007) log. Placed BEFORE subject binding so a duck-typed snapshot (never through __post_init__, whose raw-string consent_scope substring-matches 'external_measurement' inside 'no_external_measurement_allowed' and fails OPEN in the gate) can never reach the gate at all. isinstance is the right check because a REAL ConsentSnapshot has already passed __post_init__ hardening at construction. FIX 2b (same class, different site, ingest.py): the caller-supplied consent_snapshot OBJECT param was dereferenced (.consent_snapshot_id) with no type check => AttributeError out of the seam; now guarded by 'if isinstance(consent_snapshot, ConsentSnapshot)' before dereference, wrong type => absent + audit CONSENT_SNAPSHOT_UNTRUSTED_TYPE, no raise. FIX 3 (property test, new tests/test_round4_regressions.py, 26 tests): the Round-3 property test fuzzed event_ts but not non-str scalars and its reader always returned a real ConsentSnapshot -- that narrow domain is why the class survived. The new file adds targeted regressions (MAJOR-7 duck-type => egress_eligible=False + id-not-logged + audited; non-str event_code => REJECT; the 4 required scalars as list/number/None => REJECT not junk-accept; non-str guest_id dropped before the resolver ever sees it; non-str optional ids dropped absent; FIX 2b stray object => absent + audit, with a real-object control) AND a seam TYPE-BOUNDARY property test sweeping 957 wrong-type combinations (event_code x guest_id x consent-source(object+id) x reader = 945, plus 4 required scalars x 3 bad types = 12) asserting for EVERY one: ingest_event() never raises; every non-logged event carries >=1 audit; NO non-str scalar is ever logged (no junk-accept); a wrong-typed consent value never grants egress. FIX (docstring, sec.5): the seam docstring's 'never raises on hostile input' claim is now TRUE for hostile TYPES too; a Flow step T (type boundary) and a design-contract sentence were added. PLAN-DELTA (IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES Round 4 R4.3): ONE Round-3 test assertion was UPDATED (not loosened) -- test_round3_regressions.py::test_fixa_malformed_consent_state_is_audited_deny_not_raised feeds a reader-returned DUCK-TYPE and asserted reason CONSENT_STATE_MALFORMED (from the gate-call try/except); FIX 2 now catches that duck-type EARLIER at the isinstance boundary, before the gate, so the audited reason is the stronger, earlier CONSENT_SNAPSHOT_UNTRUSTED_TYPE. The test's security invariant is UNCHANGED and still asserted (no raise, egress_eligible is False, deny is audited); only the expected reason code moved -- a direct, necessary consequence of the mandated FIX 2, not a green-washing loosen. The gate-call try/except (CONSENT_STATE_MALFORMED) is KEPT as defense-in-depth (belt-and-suspenders after FIX 2). No other R1/R2/R3 test changed; two private helpers (_require_str, _field_type_reject) were added to IngestService with no public method, no new IngestResult field, and no ingest_event() signature change, so every existing caller binds unchanged.
